fact_text: Some estimates put Pakistan's cash economy at over 12,000 billion, though the interviewee acknowledged that estimates differ widely.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan has about 100 million mobile wallets against a population of about 250 million, so wallet transfers have become a familiar option.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said about 85% of bank transactions by count take place outside branches, through ATMs, cards, mobile and internet banking and wallets, with 15% inside branches.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Large businesses, corporates and SMEs still do most high-value transactions in branches, such as letters of credit, large transfers and remittances, so branch numbers will not fall quickly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee described Pakistan's retail and informal sector as heavily cash-reliant, a structural feature that slows the shift to digital payments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee argued that a weak tax culture keeps small retailers in cash, since many fear that accepting digital payments will pull them into the tax net.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan has only about two to four million tax filers, and that documented economies with a strong tax culture show higher digital payment penetration.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said about 70% of advanced economies are digitized, and that offering cash in those markets can draw suspicion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Open banking lets outside fintechs connect to bank systems through APIs; the interviewee said banks that ring-fence new innovation will hold back growth in the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said the State Bank has long pushed open banking so that fintechs can connect to bank systems and compete on innovation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Pakistan's fintech startup wave of the past five to ten years saw many entrants come and go, and the interviewee said only firms with strong business cases stayed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: RAAST is the State Bank's domestic payment platform, which settles account-to-account transfers instantly, replacing waits of a minute or two for confirmation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: RAAST maps a customer's mobile number to a bank account, so a sender needs only the phone number to pay the recipient.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Global card schemes such as Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay and American Express operate in Pakistan, but the interviewee said a domestic scheme keeps local transactions settling locally rather than abroad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan's remittance inflows reached about 40 billion dollars in 2026, a lifeline for the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Official-channel remittances credit to the recipient within about one hour, which the interviewee said pulls flows away from hawala and hundi grey channels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The government has offered incentives to route remittances through official channels, which the interviewee said benefits the government, banks and merchants alike.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Official remittance channels bring foreign currency into the banking system, so policy aims to make them easier and cheaper than grey channels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Card payments carry a merchant discount rate (MDR) of about 1% to 2% of the sale, charged to the merchant rather than the customer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee estimated the hidden cost of handling cash at about 5% to 6%, compared with roughly 1% to 2% for digital payments, which is why digital is cheaper for merchants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Merchants who accepted cards said their sales rose two to five times, as card holders opened a credit-buying customer base that paid in cash before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Cash handling brings pilferage and mis-handling losses, and cash-in-transit firms add delay because cash must be collected, counted and deposited before it reaches the merchant's account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Customers use wallets for small daily purchases but keep their savings with banks, which the interviewee said gives banks a lasting trust advantage over wallets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Digital payments need both merchant terminals and customer acceptance, and the interviewee said this chicken-and-egg problem slowed adoption in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said that even a 2% to 3% cost saving on billions of rupees of cash flow adds up to millions of rupees for the economy, though he gave no sector figure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: After Faysal Bank introduced its chatbot, about 20% to 30% of call-centre traffic moved to automated channels, which the bank treats as a cost saving.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's RAAST-based QR platform is processing billions of rupees a month, according to the bank.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank places QR codes at small merchants such as dhabas and university cafeterias, where customers pay by scanning without any training.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: A card terminal costs about 200 to 300 dollars, which small merchants rarely invest in, so QR codes are a cheaper way to bring them into digital payments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's smart ATMs let customers tap a phone with its app instead of inserting a card, cutting the wait of about 30 seconds that card insertion used to need.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank is a Shariah-compliant Islamic bank, and the interviewee said its Noor credit card is the only Shariah-compliant credit card in the market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's digital lending pre-fills application forms from data already held, so existing customers mostly confirm details rather than sign paper forms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Digital supply-chain financing lets banks lend to distributors, manufacturers and suppliers based on digitally tracked sales volumes instead of paper statements.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Faysal Bank partnered with the local startup Hubble on digital supply-chain financing for manufacturers and their distributors and suppliers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The State Bank has sped up and simplified the licensing process for digital banks, which the interviewee said may enter SME lending that conventional banks have neglected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Fraud rises as digital use grows; banks use AI to flag transactions that are impossible by location, such as a card used abroad hours after a local purchase.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Impersonation calls that trick customers into sharing passwords are a main fraud route, so banks repeatedly warn customers never to share credentials.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said cybersecurity worries remain a barrier to wider digital payment acceptance among some customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Google Wallet entered Pakistan around 2025, which the interviewee said signalled that the market had become large enough for international players.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said about 70% to 80% of phones in Pakistan run Android, the base that makes Google Pay relevant to users.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: Apple Pay is expected to enter Pakistan before the end of 2026, which the interviewee said is a strong signal of confidence in the market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)

fact_text: AI is moving from chatbots toward virtual call-centre agents that customers may not be able to tell apart from human staff, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Future Of Digital Banking: Is Pakistan Finally Moving Beyond Cash? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-26)
